content: {"like":["Improved video and audio quality with 4K transfer on Spider‑Man 1","Better bonus material including commentaries, making‑of features, gag reel and easter eggs","Attractive book‑type holder with laminated sleeves","Spider‑Man 1’s quirkiness and strong performances by McGuire, Simmons and Defoe","Spider‑Man 2’s cast and Alfred Molina as Dr. Octopus","Spider‑Man 3’s first hour and the scene where Spider‑Man sheds his black costume","Director’s Cut of Spider‑Man 3’s added score and darker tone","Overall coherence of the trilogy and its lasting appeal"],"dislike":["Lack of 4K transfer for Spider‑Man 2 and 2.1","Spider‑Man 2.1’s poorer pacing and lack of story improvement","Spider‑Man 3’s over‑ambitious plot and weak handling of Venom","Missed opportunity for better Goblin makeup and performance","Director’s Cut’s poorly edited scenes and ineffective changes","Limited bonus material on Disc 2 due to dual versions","Discomfort with the case’s slightly tight sleeves"]}
